_comment: AGENT_V3/D question bank. Read by scripts/agent_eval.py. Placeholders in `q` ({report}, {stranger}, {self}, {report2}) are filled from the fixture tenant at run time, so this file contains NO names and cannot rot when the seed changes. `probe` names a ground-truth computation the runner performs ITSELF with the same scoped tools; `must_include` lists which of that probe's fields have to appear in the answer. Every case is additionally subject to the two hard gates (scope-safety, no-fabrication) whatever it asks for.
